assumptions: Uses only regular-season weekly stat lines before the fixture week.
Shared pace and complementary pass/run scripts drive correlated team opportunities.
A team's pass attempts are distributed across modeled receivers and an untracked-other bucket; receptions and yards follow target draws.
A team's carry attempts are distributed across modeled rushers and an other bucket; quarterback passing yards equal modeled + untracked receiving yards.
Spread and total are bounded scenario inputs when provided, not independently validated signals.
limitations: UNCALIBRATED: raw simulated hit rates must not be interpreted as verified true probabilities or fair sportsbook odds.
No verified game-day actives, routes, weather, red-zone targets, receiver TD allocation, or offensive line grades.
Zero/missing stat distinctions, changing roles and opponent defensive efficiency remain imperfect.
Sampling variance is not model uncertainty. Thirty thousand draws cannot fix biased assumptions.
Unknown QB proxy preserves team passing volume but cannot generate a quarterback prop.

notes: All game and player outcomes share one indexed 30,000-trial NFL game state.
Team score shocks use sampled quarterback TDs, passing/rushing yardage, shared pace and same-game scoring conditions.
Team-score injury point adjustments and game residual dispersion are research heuristics awaiting walk-forward calibration.
Historical score-driven team model. Current opponent form and home-field are weighted research inputs.
Tied simulated scores are usually resolved by an uncalibrated overtime heuristic; rare ties remain.
Absence adjustments are heuristic; player replacements and game-day activations are not verified.
Uncalibrated raw frequencies are not fair odds, BetMGM prices, or verified betting edges.
Quarterback replacement is not confirmed by recent starts; model uses wider score uncertainty and conservative team-score adjustment. This is NOT a verified starter forecast.
Fit recency shrinkage, home edge, league points and residual variance to actual earlier-season games.
Chronological examples exclude the target week; prior completed weeks may update the live training set.
Training fit does NOT establish calibrated ML/spread/total outcome probabilities.
